home.zero_reference: User-stated physical zero: all four motors at raw 512 with the arm straight, read as vertical. CAD equivalent is q=(0,-35,-55,0) deg, so raw_at_cad_zero j2..j4 = 631.35/699.55/512. Directions are inferred, not measured.
home.arm1_j1_status: UNRESOLVED: simulation j1 direction is -1 because the bases now face -Y and zone A is on the arm left. The real direction is unmeasured. Firmware home_A raw 90 is 123.75 deg from raw 512, while zone A only needs about 30 deg. raw_at_cad_zero 192.3 keeps the simulated +30 deg placeholder until motor 17 is read on the real arm.
home.assumption_note: Simulation only. Not measured calibration; the wrist upper limit was widened to 1.65 rad in simulation so raw 825 fits, without physical clearance checks.
